import numpy as np
from scipy import stats

MAX_DRIVERS = 5

def design(feats):
    # Get features with strong effect sizes (top 10 by absolute difference in means)
    effect_sizes = []
    for fid in feats.ids:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        mean_y0 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==0, col_idx])
        mean_y1 = np.mean(feats.x[feats.y==1, col_idx])
        effect_sizes.append(abs(mean_y1 - mean_y0))
    
    # Select top 5 features by effect size
    top_indices = np.argsort(effect_sizes)[::-1][:5]
    selected_features = [feats.ids[i] for i in top_indices]
    
    # Check for correlation between top features
    corr_matrix = np.corrcoef(feats.x[:, [feats.column(fid) for fid in selected_features]].T)
    
    # If any highly correlated pairs exist, select only one from each pair
    to_remove = set()
    for i in range(len(selected_features)):
        for j in range(i+1, len(selected_features)):
            if abs(corr_matrix[i,j]) >= 0.6:
                # Remove the one with lower t-statistic
                fid1, fid2 = selected_features[i], selected_features[j]
                t1 = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid1)], 
                                    feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid1)])[0]
                t2 = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, feats.column(fid2)], 
                                    feats.x[feats.y==0, feats.column(fid2)])[0]
                if abs(t1) < abs(t2):
                    to_remove.add(fid1)
                else:
                    to_remove.add(fid2)
    
    # Final selected features
    final_features = [fid for fid in selected_features if fid not in to_remove]
    
    # Weighted score based on t-statistics
    loadings = {}
    for fid in final_features:
        col_idx = feats.column(fid)
        t_stat = stats.ttest_ind(feats.x[feats.y==1, col_idx], 
                                feats.x[feats.y==0, col_idx])[0]
        loadings[fid] = float(t_stat)
    
    return Design(
        drivers=(),
        columns=final_features,
        products=(),
        loadings=loadings
    )
